children: Citizens Community Bancorp approved a new share repurchase authorization for up to 482,500 common shares through September 1, 2027.
Board authorized repurchase of up to 482,500 common shares, replacing prior July 2025 program.
Previous plan expired July 23, 2026 with 112,867 shares remaining unrepurchased.
Repurchases may occur on the open market under Rule 10b-18 and via Rule 10b5-1 trading plans.
Authorization may be amended or terminated by the Board; repurchases depend on price and market conditions.
